name: Cable Woodchop
steps: Set a handle on a high pulley and stand side-on, feet shoulder width.
Hold the handle with both hands, arms straight above the near shoulder.
Breathe out and pull the handle down across your body to the far knee.
Let your back foot pivot as your shoulders turn.
Return slowly to the start; switch sides after the set.
cues: Arms long, turn from the trunk
Breathe out as you chop down

common_mistakes.fix: Keep the arms long; turn the shoulders

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back at the bottom
common_mistakes.fix: Bend the knees slightly and keep the chest up
Return the handle slowly over 2 seconds
